title: Light Yagami Laugh
blurb: Light Yagami's laugh from Death Note is the definitive anime villain cackle: the sound of a teenager who has just confirmed that his absurdly elaborate plan worked and cannot physically keep it inside any longer. It escalates gorgeously, from a smug private chuckle into full theatrical howling, and it has been pasted over every smug reveal on the internet for the better part of fifteen years. Keep it ready for the moment your own ridiculous scheme actually comes together.
origin: Light Yagami's triumphant laugh from Death Note.
